key_fiscal_facts.value_text: 25% corporate income tax (selskabsskat). Standard Danish CIT rate. Separate from 52% Hydrocarbon Tax (kulbrinteskat / HC-skat). Combined: 25% CIT + 52% HC-tax = 77% effective rate on petroleum income. CIT base: gross revenue minus OPEX, CAPEX depreciation, royalty, HC-tax payment (CIT is deductible from HC-tax base).
None — no royalty in Danish upstream fiscal regime

20% carried interest via Nordsofonden (state entity in Danish Underground Consortium). Nordsofonden participates in all DUC licenses on carried basis — exploration costs advanced by licensees (A.P. Moller, TotalEnergies, Nordsofonden) and recovered from production revenues. State receives both Nordsofonden equity dividend and hydrocarbon tax revenue.
